summary: SPED Fiscal export with excluir_creditos_despesa_st flag - BUG FIX VERIFIED
seed_data_creation: None - used existing company COMERCIAL RS LTDA with 01/2026 competência (25217 items, 333 despesa/ST items)
context_for_next_testing_agent: The bug fix for SPED export with excluir_creditos_despesa_st flag has been verified. When the flag is TRUE, all 333 despesa/ST CFOPs (1556, 2556, 1403, 2403, 1407, 2407, etc.) correctly have ICMS=0 in the generated SPED C170 records. Frontend files ExportSPED.js and ExportMenu.js correctly send excluir_creditos_despesa_st and aplicar_beneficio_fiscal parameters.

bug_fix_verification.issue: SPED Fiscal being generated with ICMS values for despesa and ST entries even with checkbox marked to exclude
bug_fix_verification.root_cause: Frontend was sending incorrect parameter names (zerarIcmsSt instead of excluir_creditos_despesa_st)
bug_fix_verification.fix_applied: Frontend parameter names corrected to match backend API: excluir_creditos_despesa_st and aplicar_beneficio_fiscal
